comments.body: Shipped. Support can close the 'where are editor shortcuts' macros.

content.text: Shipped. Support can close the 'where are editor shortcuts' macros.

Keyboard shortcuts for the editor only appear in an external PDF that support links out of product. In-app help drawer lists empty under the Shortcuts section because the data source never received the editor bindings.

Extend help-drawer/shortcuts.json with the editor set: Cmd/Ctrl+B/I/U, Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+C for code block, Cmd/Ctrl+Alt+M for comment, and / for the slash menu. Platform-specific labels must resolve from the user agent so Mac and Windows strings stay correct.
Done when the help drawer Shortcuts tab shows the editor group, search finds 'code block', and a unit test freezes the JSON shape against schema version 3.
